why: Move to… an SSH machine (cmuxterm-hq#8734): the target rule, the acpmux session move call and its answer are in Rust (cmux-cloud-start-core moves::targets) and the run is in CmuxNextCloud (SSHChatMoveRun). The App keeps only the glue that needs AppServices: CloudMoveTargets reads the chat's record, services.machines.cloud/ssh, services.devices' acpmux peers and the lane's peer into the rule's input; CloudHandlers+Move binds agent.moveToMachine (bindEffect, .waiting(.externalProcess)) and opens the moved chat through sessionTransfer.openChat and closes the old tab; AgentTabs+Wiring dispatches each row to the action Rust names. It moves with the Cloud folder to CmuxNextCloud (architecture-refactor-DESIGN.md).
